links.comparator_used: Simple LLM prompting (and a rule-based NLP algorithm) using the same domain-tuned LLM (LLAMAv3.2)
links.outcome: ECOG status extraction accuracy (binary any-ECOG-documented vs none); also sensitivity and the three-class outcome
links.effect: CoT accuracy 94% vs simple prompting 86% (rule-based 91%); CoT had the highest sensitivity (0.98); three-class accuracy CoT 0.87 (DFT 0.91); in the QUEST human evaluation CoT scored higher than the simple prompt on output quality, reasoning, bias reduction and user satisfaction
links.tradeoff: Computational cost and the need for human oversight were named as implementation considerations; all methods, including CoT, sometimes hallucinated ECOG status.
links.quote: Both CoT and double filtering technique (DFT) achieved 94% accuracy, outperforming the rule-based method (91%) and simple prompting (86%).

design_hint: Advanced prompting (chain-of-thought, double filtering) for LLM extraction
